title: Partitions – Boarding & Close-up
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Correct board type, thickness and number of layers, with joints staggered?
Screw type, spacing and edge distance to the manufacturer and wall type?
Is insulation the right type and thickness, fitted tight with no gaps?
Are GFS1 straps fitted behind horizontal board joints where required?
Has the MEP handover been received and photos taken before the second side closes?
questions.source: Errigal ITP – hold point before closure

questions.q: Are cavities clear of debris before closing?
Is the wall within tolerance for line, level and plumb?
Glasroc board joints staggered by at least 600 mm where required?
Plaster beads fixed with ≥75 mm steel fixings at ≤450 mm centres?
Riser door perimeter gaps 3 mm (±1 mm), lock/cylinder working?
Air temperature between +5°C and +30°C during boarding and jointing?
